references.text: The Lord promised Abraham that Ishmael would also become a great nation.
The angel foretells that Ishmael's descendants will be numerous and live in conflict with their relatives.
Ishmael's descendants are listed, fulfilling God's promise to make him into a great nation.
God repeats the promise to Hagar that He will make her son into a great nation.
Complementary promises about nation-building: Isaac as the heir of the covenant and Ishmael as the father of his own people.
Theological expansion of 'Abraham's offspring': The promise also includes those outside the primary covenant line (Ishmael/believers).
